prompt_transform.guidance: For keyframes, lock subject placement, scene geography, lighting source, and major props.
prompt_transform.template: Continuity: anchor {subject} in {scene} with stable placement, light source, and props.

negative_constraints: Do not change room layout or object placement across adjacent keyframes.
Do not alter character identity between keyframes.
quality_checks: Subject and scene anchors are reusable.

source_refs.label: Runway Academy Prompting Guide
source_refs.note: Image-to-video uses image content for composition and style while prompts guide motion.

prompt_transform.guidance: A keyframe should represent one readable moment, not a full sequence of actions.
prompt_transform.template: Action/Beat: freeze one decisive moment of {action} with {subject} readable.

negative_constraints: Do not ask a still keyframe to show before, during, and after at once.
Do not describe temporal motion as if it must all appear in one image.
quality_checks: The still image has one decisive moment.

source_refs.label: Google Gemini image prompting guide
source_refs.note: Image prompts benefit from precise editing and composition instructions.

prompt_transform.guidance: Carry lighting direction, contrast, palette, and grain or texture between keyframes.
prompt_transform.template: Continuity: maintain lighting style {lighting} and project look {style} across related frames.

negative_constraints: Do not shift color temperature between adjacent shots unless intentional.
Do not let style preference change the established lighting logic.
quality_checks: Lighting can match across generated frames.

source_refs.label: DeepMind Veo prompt guide
source_refs.note: Lighting and style are explicit prompt control elements.

prompt_transform.guidance: Add concise negative constraints for identity drift, extra limbs, text artifacts, distorted props, and continuity breaks.
prompt_transform.template: Negative Constraints: no identity drift, no extra limbs, no unintended text, no distorted key props, no continuity break.

negative_constraints: Do not add a long generic negative prompt that dilutes the main request.
Do not include unsafe or private reference data.
quality_checks: Negative constraints address likely generation failure modes.

source_refs.label: Google Gemini image prompting guide
source_refs.note: Precise instructions help preserve style, lighting, and composition.
